claim.summary: For a finite row-parameter set A of Boolean functions q_a on a finite Omega and any F2-valued predicate sigma of their product, sum_(a1,...,ah) sigma(product q_ai)=sum_a sigma(q_a) in F2 for every h>=1. Formal Boolean-function monoid algebra gives Q^2=Q. The same holds for multiple independent blocks and joint predicates of their products. For identical binary row grids, the full-row coefficient of the multilinear success indicator equals one-active-row success parity, pointwise in weight-chart parameters. For a fixed fresh source batch with binary degree<=T polynomial row maps, degree<=delta_a old inputs and weight degree<=b, b+max_a{h_a(T+delta_a)+delta_a,2T}<=D makes complete weighted companion success a product-function predicate. Original replay separately pays b+TB<=D. Raw-row-dependent later readers are excluded.
claim.assessment: Working elementary identity and exact paid source application, medium reviewed. The formal monoid algebra is not the old charged quotient; Boolean reduction justifies equality of low-degree representatives. No nonvanishing or arbitrary-source success theorem, no efficient enumeration of functions, and no loss of original accuracy costs under zero padding.

claim.summary: For a codimension-t subspace of s-by-m matrices over Fq, s>=2,m>=1, t<m guarantees a rank-one element u v^T for every fixed first-factor u with u0=1 and some nonzero v. This threshold is sharp from dimension data alone: first-row-zero codes fail for every t>=m; at s2,m>=2 a field-multiplication graph has codimension m and surjective first-row projection but no marked rank-one element. In the binary complete one-active-row source relation map with surviving degree-b weight domain, degree-delta inputs and degree-T features, b+TB<=D, B>=2delta+1, marked rank one is equivalent to a weight and legal binary feature coefficients killing all companions; fields follow from old Booleanity. The codimension guarantee already works with all coefficients zero, recovering the existing common kernel. Multiple active rows are not encoded by this linear map.
claim.assessment: Elementary working criterion and source linearization, reviewed with exact fixed controls. The complete tuple (x,y,x+y), weight one, has no constant marked solution but has affine polynomial maps at the same relation codimension3; degree-three Boolean certificates supplied. Abstract graph calibration is not claimed to be a hard-PC source realization.
